items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is dealing with a rib injury and is now considered day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh. Team wants to see how he feels this week before determining Sunday availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Hard hit on pass over middle in Q3, exited and did not return; testing Monday.
items.implication: Week 2 status up in air; monitor practice Wed-Fri. LAC offense struggled after exit.
items.opportunity: If out, boost to Quentin Johnston and other LAC WRs for targets/routes.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers left early with hamstring injury that is not considered serious. MRI upcoming but would have returned if playoff game; day-to-day. Coach confirms DTD, good sign.
items.why: Sources: not serious; playoff return likely. Confirmed by coach.
items.implication: Positive for Week 2 availability; monitor MRI/practice.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, more targets to other BAL pass-catchers including Likely/Andrews.

items.text: Lions incredibly concentrated: no RB2 usage, WR3 can't earn targets, no TE2. Gibbs, ARSB, LaPorta, Jamo accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%).
items.why: As expected for good offense; extreme opportunity funnel.
items.implication: Elite floor/ceiling for the four; fade others on DET.
items.opportunity: 93% opp share locks in RB1/WR1/TE1/WR2 roles.

items.text: Very disappointing box score for Colston Loveland but two almost-plays. 92% route participation. Want all the Loveland and buying low where I can.
items.why: Elite route % despite quiet day; near-misses.
items.implication: Buy-low TE1 upside; ignore box score.
items.opportunity: 92% routes = featured in CHI pass game.
items.conflict: Berry also lists concern for Loveland in recap, but buy signal dominates.

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak said he now considers TE Brock Bowers to be day-to-day after last week’s meniscus trim.
items.implication: Potential return sooner than expected; monitor for Week 2.
items.opportunity: If active, elite TE usage; if out, Mayer or others benefit.

items.text: Surprised Travis Etienne didn't dominate more with Alvin Kamara (knee) out. Snaps: Etienne 53, Miller 26, Donaldson 15. Routes: 24/7/5. Opportunities: 18/9/4.
items.why: Kamara not expected/out; Etienne led but shared significantly.
items.implication: Not full dominate; committee risk persists even without Kamara.
items.opportunity: Etienne still clear lead in snaps/routes/opps; Miller handcuff value.
items.conflict: Berry concern for Etienne; usage confirms incomplete takeover.

items.text: Malik Nabers in first game since ACL+meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets (31% share), 6-69-0. Emerged healthy. Late active decision (family not there).
items.why: Late decision ~2hrs pre-kick; solid route/target share post long layoff.
items.implication: Start with confidence ROS if healthy; decoy risk minimal given usage.
items.opportunity: High route % and target share signals featured role immediately.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE. Risk/reward RB2 but wouldn't activate if worried about injury. Starting him everywhere. Cardinals risk remains.
items.why: Officially active post ankle; team confidence implied.
items.implication: Start as RB2 with risk; ETR expected to play.
items.opportunity: Lead back role if healthy enough for activation.

items.text: Weekend reports summary: EXPECTED TO PLAY Jeremiyah Love (ankle), Rome Odunze (calf). NOT EXPECTED Alvin Kamara (knee). NO NEWS YET Malik Nabers (knee) [later active].
items.implication: Start Love/Odunze; fade Kamara, pivot Etienne; Nabers resolved active.
items.opportunity: Kamara out opens Saints RB; Love/Odunze green lights.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks. Even with Dylan Sampson (knee) out early, Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Low pass-game involvement despite backup opportunity.
items.opportunity: Monitor if role expands; Sanders got equal routes.

items.text: Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage: only 8 carries (1 rush TD), 21 routes, 7 targets (all caught). But only RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked extremely healthy. Good matchup vs CLE next.
items.why: Goal-line work + route win + health despite modest volume.
items.implication: Positive for RB2/Flex with TD upside; healthy return signal.
items.opportunity: Goal-line monopoly and pass-game edge over Gainwell.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid finally over PCL: 42/57 snaps (74%), 22 routes on 32 Allen dropbacks (69%). Will move needle when on field.
items.why: High snap/route shares post injury recovery.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout SZN is well under way.
items.why: Strong Week 1 performance signals expanded role.
items.implication: Start/roster as TE upside, especially with Flowers DTD.
items.opportunity: Breakout potential in BAL TE room.
corroboration: FF Happy Hour: time for Likely

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze officially is active today.
items.why: Official active after calf concerns; ETR expected.
items.implication: Start if rostered; boosts CHI pass game with Loveland.
